name: MoonClerk API
description:
A **read-only** REST-style API. Every operation is a `GET`; forms, plans, and pricing are configured in the MoonClerk interface, not over the API.

## Authentication

Pass your API key in the `Authorization` header as an authorization token:

```
Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_KEY
```

This is **not** a Bearer token. Generate a key at <https://app.moonclerk.com/settings/api-key>. Anyone holding the key can read your account data, so keep it private.

## Versioning

The API version travels in the `Accept` header, which is **required**:

```
Accept: application/vnd.moonclerk+json;version=1
```

That media type is the response content type for every operation below. JSON is the only supported format.

## A complete request

```shell
curl https://api.moonclerk.com/forms \
  -H "Authorization: Token token=YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.moonclerk+json;version=1"
```

## Paging

List operations return 10 rows by default. Use `count` (1–100) and `offset`.

## Field conventions

- Dates are ISO 8601 in UTC.
- Money fields are integers denominated in **cents**, alongside a `currency` field.
- Any key ending in `_reference` is the corresponding Stripe ID.

## Throttling

Exceeding the rate limit returns `429 Too Many Requests`. Reduce the number and frequency of calls and retry later. No `RateLimit` response headers are currently published.

## Errors

Error responses are currently `text/plain`, not JSON.
